title: The composer's commands, files and `!` commands
description: GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/commands and GET /api/v1/workspaces/commands?workspace_id= (Pi's own command list, from the running Pi or a short-lived list-only Pi), GET /api/v1/workspaces/files?workspace_id=[&query=[&rank=name]], GET /api/v1/workspaces/file_tree?workspace_id=[&folder=] and GET /api/v1/workspaces/file_preview?workspace_id=&path= (the workspace's file names, its folders and one bounded preview, read as the person), and POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/bash and /abort_bash (a typed `!` or `!!` command relayed to Pi as RPC bash). The conversation status carries the command's state as `bash`.

command.description: One entry of Pi's get_commands without its source path. terminal_only: the command opens Pi's own terminal dialogs, so the browser lists it but cannot run it.

commandList.description: answered_by: running (the conversation's Pi) or helper (a list-only Pi that started no conversation and wrote no session).

startPageReply.description: GET /api/v1/workspaces/start_page?workspace_id=: file-only observation independent of Pi. Skill references are authored data, resolved against get_commands before preparing an invocation.

startPage.description: Authored workspace .agents/start-page.md. YAML frontmatter supplies title and goals; the Markdown body is free text. Absent is null; invalid or unreadable returns startPageUnavailable. Only effective native skill references may become invocations.

name.description: The name of a conversation this goal starts, one line of at most 160 UTF-8 bytes (the daemon refuses a longer one); the goal's title when absent.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the workspace root, never absolute and without empty, . or .. parts.

fileList.description: At most 200 matches, by fuzzy score of the whole path; Git's path order without a query. rank=name orders a query's matches by the file's own name instead: the whole name (with or without its extension), a part of it, its letters in order, then a match only in the folders (a query with a slash is read against the whole path); within each, changed files first, then the shallowest, then the path. matched: the matches before the bound. truncated: the workspace or the matches had more. An unavailable list is an error, never an empty list.

folderPath.description: A folder relative to the workspace root ending with a slash; the empty string is the workspace itself.

treeEntry.description: One direct child of a folder: a file with its Git mark, or a subfolder (its path ends with a slash) with the number of changed files beneath it.

fileTree.description: The workspace's folders from the same file names the file list reads. Without folder: the top folder and every folder that holds a change, shallowest first; with folder: that folder first, then the folders above it. Paths with line breaks or other control characters are left out. At most 32 folders, 500 entries a folder and 4000 in all; a cut folder keeps its subfolders and changed files first. changed: the workspace's changed files. truncated: the workspace had more files than were read or a requested folder was left out.

filePreview.description: Git's diff of a changed file, or the first lines of another regular file beneath the workspace; at most 40 lines and 8 KiB.

bashRequest.description: The command text without its `!`; exclude_from_context is `!!`: Pi records the output but never gives it to the model.

bashReply.description: running: written to the running Pi. held: Pi is not running yet; the command runs once the Pi this starts is ready. accepted: the reply of abort_bash.

bashStatus.description: The conversation status field `bash`: the last `!` command of this daemon incarnation, or null. not_started: its Pi did not start, or it was taken back before it ran; it is never run later. uncertain: Pi ended or the write was lost before the outcome was known.
